parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the cloud service that is connected to WAF.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The cloud service type. Valid values:

- **clb4**: Layer 4 CLB.

- **clb7**: Layer 7 CLB.

- **ecs**: ECS.
- **nlb**: NLB.
